question: What kind of teaching is said to be heard abiding in the ear, addressed to the Goddess, when it has come down through a succession of tradition?
premises: Something abiding in the ear is heard.
The address is made to the Goddess.
That which is heard has come down through the order of tradition.
inference: That which abides in the ear and comes down through tradition is heard, O Goddess.
uncertainties: Content of what is heard not specified
plain_english: O Goddess, that which comes down through tradition is heard abiding in the ear.
